focus_area: Authorization + controller/routes/serializer correctness (AiJobCriteriaController show+create, config/routes.rb nested singleton, JobAiJobCriteriaSerializer)

findings.title: Serializer issues the latest-row lookups twice each (2 distinct queries run 4 times); consistent with codebase convention
findings.description: The four attribute methods delegate to unmemoized Job model methods that each run a SQL query. `criteria` (line 7) and `extracted_at` (line 11) both call `object.latest_succeeded_ai_job_criteria` (job.rb:692, a fresh `ai_job_criteria.status_succeeded.order(...).first` query). `status` (line 15) calls `object.latest_ai_job_criteria` (job.rb:688) and `zero_criteria_failure` (line 19) calls `object.zero_criteria_extraction_failure?` (job.rb:696) which internally calls `latest_ai_job_criteria` again. Net effect: two distinct queries are each executed twice per single-record render (4 queries total where 2 would do). This is NOT a correctness defect — it is a single-object `render_one` endpoint (not a list), so there is no per-row N+1; results are identical either way; and it matches the surrounding convention (the analog `OrganizationAiCreditBalanceSerializer` and the Job model methods are also unmemoized). Reported only for completeness; no action required.
findings.recommendation: None required (convention-consistent, negligible on a settings endpoint). If ever optimized, memoize `latest_succeeded_ai_job_criteria` / `latest_ai_job_criteria` on the Job instance.
